connection_adapters.instagram: Meta OAuth ready when provider app credentials are supplied

connection_adapters.linkedin: LinkedIn OAuth adapter installed; provider app approval/credentials required
connection_adapters.youtube: Google/YouTube OAuth and publish backend installed; provider credentials required
connection_adapters.x: OAuth 2.0 PKCE adapter installed; provider credentials required

notes: No social accounts were connected during certification.
External provider authorization cannot be completed until the owner chooses to create/approve provider developer apps and supplies their credentials.

Direct social publishing currently exists for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube through their dedicated production paths; other platforms are connection-ready but do not yet have direct publishing adapters.
